disclaimer.title: Not financial advice.
disclaimer.footer: Shinrin is an educational analysis tool built on public data, which can be delayed or wrong. It never places orders or connects to brokerages. Investment decisions are yours alone.
disclaimer.analysis: Scores, fair values and timing views are computed from public data by fixed rules. They are opinions that can be wrong, not recommendations to buy or sell.

home.title: Markets, scored the way analysts screen them
home.intro: Shinrin collects prices, filings and news for B3 and US investments, scores each asset against its peers, and estimates fair value ranges and timing. Everything works without AI; reports with your own LLM key come later.
home.outlookHint: Bands come from the profile and lean with real interest rates and the US yield curve.

explore.title: Explore
explore.intro: Assets ranked by the composite score for your risk profile. Only assets the scoring routine has scored appear here.
explore.empty: Nothing scored yet for this filter. Scores appear after the nightly scoring routine runs.

asset.compositeHint: Weighted for a {profile} profile. Coverage: {coverage} of the weights had data.
asset.notScored: This asset has not been scored yet. Scores appear after the nightly scoring routine runs with enough data.
asset.dataGapsHint: What could not be computed, and why. Missing data is left out of scores rather than counted as zero.
asset.chartHint: Close adjusted for dividends and splits.
asset.noPrices: No prices stored for this range.
asset.noDividends: No cash distributions stored in the last 5 years.
asset.noNews: No headlines in the last 90 days.

factor.title: Factor scores
factor.hint: Each factor is a 0 to 100 percentile against peers, where higher is always better for the investor (a high risk score means low risk). Expand a factor to see why.

fairValue.title: Fair value ranges
fairValue.hint: Estimates from simple models, shown as ranges. The marker is the last close.
fairValue.none: No fair value model had enough data.

signals.uptrend: Price and the 50-day average are above the 200-day average.
signals.downtrend: Price and the 50-day average are below the 200-day average.
signals.macd_positive: MACD is above its signal line (momentum improving).
signals.macd_negative: MACD is below its signal line (momentum fading).
signals.rsi_overbought: RSI is above 70: the recent rise looks stretched.
signals.rsi_oversold: RSI is below 30: selling looks overdone.
signals.near_low_cheap: Near the 52-week low while valuation looks cheap.
signals.near_high_expensive: Near the 52-week high while valuation looks expensive.
signals.below_fair_value: Price is below the fair value range of most models.
signals.above_fair_value: Price is above the fair value range of most models.
signals.high_real_rate_br: Brazil's real interest rate is high: post-fixed bonds pay well for little risk.
signals.low_real_rate_br: Brazil's real interest rate is low: fixed income pays little above inflation.
signals.us_curve_inverted: The US yield curve is inverted (10-year below 3-month), a classic recession warning.
signals.us_curve_normal: The US yield curve is upward sloping.
